input_rule: Read the supplied immutable CIF directly; CCDC database retrieval is not required or scored. Verify archive ID, formula, elements, occupancy and cell; select the molecular component labelled compound 1, preserve deposited atom identities and stereochemical/connectivity information, do not edit the raw CIF, and do not use paper/SI optimized coordinates as input.
comparison_rule: Use these six pairs, each once. The primary experimental lengths are supplied in experimental_bonds.json at the published precision; independently calculate optimized distances from your mapped cis geometry.
target_conformer: The cis local-minimum conformer about the pyridine-quinoxaline C1-C2 bond: pyridyl N1 and adjacent quinoxaline N2 on the same side. Document the mapped N1-C1-C2-N2 torsion. This does not designate the global lowest-energy conformer.
